verdict.rationale: Mercury's REST API exposes accounting-relevant data with read and write operations. It covers listing and getting transactions, updating transaction metadata, uploading attachments, full CRUD on categories, statement PDFs, merchants, and treasury statements. A dedicated Accounts Receivable API handles customers and invoices, and scoped read-only, read-write, and custom tokens plus a sandbox support integration work. Missing for 10: ledger-level accounting objects (chart of accounts, journal entries, GL export), since accounting sync is otherwise delegated to QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite integrations; independent hands-on corroboration of these endpoints.
